## Requirements (from the contract)
- **R-2.12.3 (measurement)** — the online cross-candidate spike as the acceptance check that measures the cells the offline budget could not; feeds GATE-G1 revalidation.
- **R-2.5.5 (S1 spike, cross-candidate)** — E2/E3 S1 kernel slices from the same spec; C5/C7; the cross-candidate G1 gate.
- **R-2.2.5 (S2 boundary slice, cross-candidate)** — the E5b/E5c splits; C12 transport + cross-ecosystem hash-equality.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC-G (gating, §9.1/§10.6):** M-S1-7 within band; E1/E2/E3 hash chain byte-identical (gate G1 cross-candidate half); each E2/E3/E5b/E5c C5/C7/C12 compared to ADR-0050 §3 with the ±1 verdict; the extended sheet appended to the ADR-0050 amendment log; the revalidation rule evaluated (arm on any candidate outside ±1). Repeat-score **N≥3** (distribution). No claim about any harness at Stage 0.
- **AC-U (universal phase-gate):** verification green; every new behaviour has a test that fails if removed; requirement ids stamped; anything not machine-verifiable is a DEFERRALS row + compensating control (R2 signature); ADRs for every deviation/owned decision (incl. the E2/E3 candidate→toolchain binding, CC4); BUILD_INDEX row + LEDGER advanced.
